verify_session_open placing a child grant (lacking issuer) at proof_path[0] MUST refuse GRANT_NOT_DELEGABLE.
verify_session_open for an action disallowed by executor_cfg.actions MUST refuse INVOKE_ACTION_DENIED.
verify_session_open for an action with allows_bearer_session=false MUST refuse SESSION_INVALID.

payload.terms_text: freeform text forbidden on mechanical mail/read

cases.note: verify_session_open with mechanical grant carrying terms_text MUST refuse GRANT_TEXT_FORBIDDEN.
verify_session_open for an action with requires_contract=True lacking contract_id MUST refuse GRANT_CONTRACT_REQUIRED.
Bearer session use enforces where-constraints, exact now == watermark ADMIT vs watermark-1 QUOTA_CLOCK_REGRESSION, exact used==max ADMIT, and exact now==exp SESSION_INVALID.
Depth-2 bearer session enforces parent grant exact window bounds [not_before_height, not_after_height).
Unknown migration mode MUST refuse SERVICE_MIGRATION_INVALID even when all activate proofs are valid.
Migration holder_assent at exact chain.now == issued_at MUST admit.
Migration holder_assent at exact chain.now == expires_at MUST refuse SERVICE_MIGRATION_INVALID.
Migration activate MUST propagate MANIFEST_ROLLBACK when holder manifest regresses.
Federation disclosure with wrong-network grant MUST refuse CHAIN_MISMATCH.
Federation disclosure with persisted grant closure MUST refuse GRANT_CLOSED.
Federation screening at exact tip_height == not_before_height MUST admit.
Federation screening at exact tip_height == not_after_height MUST refuse FEDERATION_POLICY_DENIED.
Wrong JSON type inside ConstraintPredicate (in: string) MUST map validator=='type' to WIRE_CONSTRAINT.
Wrong JSON type on a Uint53 field (string instead of integer) MUST map validator=='type' to WIRE_MEMBER rather than WIRE_INTEGER.
Concurrent CAS write_token fence between check_continuity and append MUST refuse JOURNAL_FENCED.
Concurrent CAS witness head drift between check_continuity and append MUST refuse JOURNAL_LOST.
Unregistered ValueError raised during journal.append MUST map fail-closed to WIRE_SIZE.
Bearer session defense-in-depth MUST refuse SESSION_INVALID at exact tip_height == parent.not_after_height.
